items.title: Witch Grinding Herbs
items.alt: A witch grinds herbs in a stone mortar beside lavender sprigs.
items.description: A witch in a green apron uses a stone mortar and pestle, two lavender sprigs laid beside the mortar, fingers wrapped naturally around the pestle. Use this illustration for botanical vocabulary cards and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Serving Pumpkin Soup
items.alt: A witch carries a pumpkin-shaped soup bowl, bread roll and spoon on a tray.
items.description: A cozy witch carries a small pumpkin-shaped soup bowl on a tray with one bread roll and spoon, wearing a plain pointed hat and oven apron. Use this illustration for personal autumn recipe pages and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Making a Moon Ornament
items.alt: A witch holds a crescent-shaped stained-glass ornament beside a box of glass pieces.
items.description: A craft witch carefully holds a finished crescent-shaped stained-glass ornament by its hanging loop, beside a small box of colorful glass shapes. Use this illustration for craft process story cards and personal crafts.
